name: Annabel-Jean Smith
source:
Anne is an honest, hard-working farm girl from just out of town. She manages her family business while she attends Starswirl with her little sister. Anne often finds herself shirking school responsibilities for her work responsibilities, but you'll never see her slacking off. Best friends/rivals with Robin.

[From [url=http://www.zap-apple.com/p/characters.html]the Starswirl Academy characters page[/url]]
